svg.title: Kanji Masta mobile Admin jobs control panel
svg.desc: Six dark mobile mockups showing all background jobs, a stale job detail, model configuration, bottom-drawer confirmations for mark failed and rerun, and a bottom-drawer model picker.
svg.text: Admin Jobs — observe, stop, recover, configure
The same 390 px control surface on mobile and desktop, with all durable work in one queue.
Rerun closes this run and creates a new attempt.
Destructive actions confirm their user-visible effect; recovery and configuration changes remain auditable.
The scan will stop appearing as Analysing
This run becomes Failed. A new attempt uses
the original stored photo and current model.
Results are fetched through the Admin API.
Swipe down or tap outside to cancel
Control contract: every transient mobile action uses a bottom drawer. Stale jobs auto-fail, rerun creates a new attempt, model configuration is versioned, and secrets never enter the browser.
Drawer motion · enter 300 ms · exit 260 ms · both directions remain visibly animated until completion
